raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, using absolute values and data from NACE Rev. 2. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows that other services account for 61% (19.0 million enterprises), trade for 19% (5.9 million), construction for 12% (3.7 million), and industry for 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," indicates that other services employ 51% (80.2 million persons), trade 19% (29.5 million), construction 21% (33.0 million), and industry 9% (13.4 million). The third chart, "TURNOVER," shows that other services have a turnover of 31% (9.9 trillion euros), trade 31% (9.8 trillion euros), construction 6% (1.9 trillion euros), and industry 33% (10.6 trillion euros). All three charts use the same color coding: industry (gold), construction (light blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue). The percentages and absolute values are explicitly labeled within each segment of the donut charts. A legend at the bottom left of the image corresponds to the color coding.
